headline: B3 Extends Trading Hours Starting Next Tuesday Due to US and European Daylight Saving End
summary: Brazil's B3 stock exchange is extending its operating hours starting Tuesday, reflecting the end of daylight saving time in the United States and Europe.
why: Exchange schedule adjustments align trading sessions with international financial centers to maintain synchronized arbitrage and liquidity windows.

impacts.name: Financial Exchanges
impacts.why: Extended trading hours alter market access schedules for institutional and retail participants.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
